name: 打绳场
Ropewalk Field
before: 一块又长又窄的空地，女人们腰上缠着麻团，一边搓一边往后退，退出几十丈，一根长绳就成了。一队码头劫骑偏要从绳场中间骑过去，马腿把绳子缠成一团乱麻，劫骑自己也被缠下了马，在地上越挣越紧。绳场的大姐们叉着腰看，谁也不去解。

A long, narrow field where women with hanks of hemp at their waists twist as they walk backwards; a few hundred feet later, a long rope is made. Dockside raiders insist on riding straight through; the horses' legs snarl the ropes, the raiders are tangled off their saddles and thrash on the ground, pulling it tighter. The ropewalk women watch with hands on hips. Nobody moves to untie them.
after: 劫骑被解开扔出了场。大姐们说，十年前沈船主在这里订过一根锚缆，要「一根能拴住三条船的」，搓了整整一个月。上船前剪下一截留作样子，至今挂在墙上，比人的胳膊还粗。她们照着那截样子，给龚墨斗又搓了一根。

The raiders are cut loose and thrown out. Ten years ago, the women say, Shipmaster Shen ordered an anchor cable here, 'one that could hold three ships', and it took a month to twist. They cut off a length as a pattern before it went aboard; it still hangs on the wall, thicker than a man's arm. Working from it, they twist another for Gong Modou.

name: 禁言茶楼
Hold-Your-Tongue Teahouse
before: 一座两层茶楼，是龙家管家福伯议事的地方，墙上贴着一张红纸：「本楼不许说千里号没了，违者罚银一两。」守楼的海寇弓手竖着耳朵听每一桌。一个外地客商随口说了句「那船早沉了吧」，当场罚了一两，又罚一两，因为他问了句「凭什么」。

A two-storey teahouse where the Long house steward, Uncle Fu, conducts business. A red notice on the wall: 'In this house no one may say the Qianli is lost. Offenders fined one tael.' The pirate archers guarding it eavesdrop on every table. An out-of-town trader said offhand, 'That ship sank long ago, surely,' and was fined a tael on the spot, then another for asking, 'On whose say-so?'
after: 弓手被赶下楼，福伯捧着茶壶没动。他说这是龙爷的规矩，整个龙记都这样，十年没人敢在龙爷跟前说那个「没」字，罚的银子都送去了义仓。福伯给你们倒了杯茶：「龙爷说，没回来，不等于没了。」

The archers are driven downstairs. Uncle Fu stays seated with his teapot. It's Master Long's rule, he says, across the whole Long house: for ten years no one has dared say 'lost' before him, and the fines all go to the charity granary. He pours you a cup. 'Master Long says not come back isn't the same as lost.'

name: 龙母摊
Dragon Mother's Stall
before: 天不亮，码头边就支起一口大锅，一个白发老太太在熬面线糊，香气飘出半条街。可没人敢来吃：锅边站着一圈海寇刀手，是龙家派来「护着老太太」的，谁靠近就瞪谁。老太太是龙四海的亲娘，儿子不许她摆摊，她偏要摆，刀手们只好站成一圈，围出一口没人敢靠近的锅。

Before dawn a great pot is set up by the docks and a white-haired old woman stews thread-noodle porridge, the smell drifting half a street. But no one dares eat: a ring of pirate swordsmen stands round the pot, sent by the Long house to 'protect the old lady', glaring at anyone who comes near. She is Long Sihai's own mother. Her son won't let her keep a stall; she insists, so they stand guard round a pot nobody dares approach.
after: 刀手们被赶走，码头苦力一拥而上。龙老太一边舀一边说，她有两个儿子，小的叫阿舟，十七岁跟着千里号上了船，是船上最小的水手。「四海拦了，没拦住。」她拿勺子敲敲锅沿：「他嘴上要钱，心里要的是人。那个泊位，是给阿舟留的。」

The swordsmen are chased off and the dock coolies surge in. Ladling away, old Mother Long says she had two sons. The younger, A'zhou, sailed with the Qianli at seventeen, its youngest hand. 'Sihai tried to stop him and couldn't.' She taps the ladle on the rim. 'He talks about money, but what he wants is people. That berth is kept for A'zhou.'

name: 船样阁
Model Loft
before: 一座小阁楼里摆满了木头小船，最大的一条有桌子那么长，桅、帆、舵孔一样不缺，船身刻着「千里」。造大船先做船样，照着样子放大。一伙海寇弓手撬了阁门，要把它偷去卖给龙记船厂。老阁主握着雕刀挡在门口，手抖得刀都快掉了，嘴还硬：「谁动它，我在他脑门上刻只王八。」

A little loft is crammed with wooden ships. The largest is as long as a table, masts, sails and rudder well complete, Qianli carved on its hull; a big ship starts as a model that is scaled up. Pirate archers have forced the door to steal it for the Long shipyard. The old keeper blocks the way with a carving knife, his hand shaking, his tongue sharp as ever: 'Touch it and I'll carve a tortoise on your forehead.'
after: 弓手被赶走，老阁主揭开船样的甲板：船肚子被一道道木板隔成十三个舱。「一舱破了进水，别的舱照样浮，船就沉不了。」这是千里号敢走远海的底气。可船尾的舵孔是空的。「舵样不在这儿，船主带走了，说要押在一个人手里。」

The archers are run off and the old keeper lifts the model's deck: the belly is divided by bulkheads into thirteen holds. 'If one hold floods, the others still float and the ship can't sink.' That was what gave the Qianli the nerve for the far seas. But the rudder well is empty. 'The rudder model isn't here. The shipmaster took it, said she'd pledge it with someone.'

name: 石蛋埕
Stone-Egg Quarry
before: 港后的山坡上滚满了圆溜溜的大石头，像谁在山上下了一窝巨蛋，石匠们叫它「石蛋」，泉州的桥、塔、码头都是这里的花岗石。一队码头劫骑把石场封了，说龙记要独家收石，石匠们没活干，只好坐在石蛋上啃番薯。场边立着一根刻好的系船石柱，十年没人拉走。

The hillside behind the harbour is strewn with great round boulders, as if something had laid a clutch of giant eggs; the masons call them stone eggs, and Quanzhou's bridges, pagodas and quays are all this granite. Dockside raiders have sealed the quarry, saying the Long house will buy all the stone, so the masons sit idle on the stone eggs eating sweet potatoes. At the yard's edge stands a finished mooring post nobody has hauled away in ten years.
after: 劫骑被赶跑，石场重开，山上的石料换港口的粮食，石匠们又叮叮当当干起来。老石匠拍着一颗石蛋说：花岗石本是一整块，顺着裂缝裂成方块，雨水渗进缝里一年年地蚀，棱角三面受蚀，最先磨圆，方石头就成了蛋。那根系船柱刻着「千里·一号」，是龙爷十年前订的：「等船回来那天，再拉去码头。」

The raiders are run off and the quarry reopens: mountain stone for harbour grain, and the chisels ring again. Patting a stone egg, the old mason explains: granite begins as one solid mass and splits into blocks along its cracks; rain seeps in and eats at them year after year, and the corners, attacked from three sides, round off first, until the square block becomes an egg. The mooring post is carved 'Qianli: Berth One'. Master Long ordered it ten years ago: 'On the day the ships come home, haul it to the quay.'

name: 代笔摊
Letter-Writer's Stall
before: 街角一个代人写信的摊子，摊主是个落第秀才，替不识字的人写家书。一队码头劫骑掀了他的桌子，在他箱子里乱翻，说是福伯交代的：箱里有些信的底稿「不能留」。秀才护着箱子，被马尾巴扫了一脸，还在念叨：「信是人家的，底稿是我的。」

On a street corner a failed scholar keeps a stall writing letters home for those who can't. Dockside raiders have overturned his table and are ransacking his chest on Uncle Fu's orders, they say: certain drafts in it 'mustn't be kept'. The scholar shields the chest, gets swatted in the face by a horse's tail, and keeps muttering, 'The letters are theirs. The drafts are mine.'
after: 劫骑走了，秀才从箱底取出一摞底稿，十封，一年一封，收信人都是「阿舟」。是龙四海每年八月口述、他代笔，写完龙爷拿去码头烧了。头一封骂他不听话，第五封问他吃得饱不饱，第十封只有一句：「泊位还留着，回来别靠错了。」

Once the raiders have gone, the scholar takes from the bottom of the chest ten drafts, one a year, all addressed to 'A'zhou'. Every August Long Sihai dictates one, the scholar writes it, and Master Long burns it at the quay. The first scolds the boy for not listening. The fifth asks if he's eating enough. The tenth is one line: 'The berth is still kept. Don't moor at the wrong one.'

name: 沉船滩
Wreck Beach
before: 沙滩上半埋着一条老福船，船板早烂了，只剩一根粗大的龙骨，像鲸鱼的脊梁。一伙海寇刀手在上面拆铁钉、撬铜件，叮叮当当砸了三天。阿樯一看就急了：「那是我师父年轻时造的头一条船！龙骨里有保寿孔！」

An old Fujian junk lies half buried in the sand, its planks long rotted, only the great keel left like a whale's spine. Pirate swordsmen have been prising out its nails and bronze fittings for three days. A'qiang takes one look and panics. 'That's the first ship my master built when he was young! There's a long-life hole in the keel!'
after: 刀手被赶走，阿樯趴在龙骨接口处，抠出小孔里的东西：几枚铜钱、一面巴掌大的铜镜，绿锈斑斑。造船的规矩，龙骨接口凿个「保寿孔」，放进铜钱和镜子，保船长寿。她揣起一枚铜钱：「师父的新船，就用这一枚。」

The swordsmen are driven off and A'qiang lies on the keel at the scarf joint, picking out a small hole's contents: a few copper coins and a palm-sized bronze mirror, green with corrosion. By shipwrights' custom a long-life hole is cut at the keel joint and coins and a mirror put in so the ship lives long. She pockets one coin. 'Master's new ship gets this one.'

name: 龙记账房
Long House Counting Room
before: 临街一座大屋，二十张账桌，二十个账先生埋头写字，是龙记的总账房。正中一块大木牌，写着一个数，每天都有人上梯子去改一笔：「一号泊欠泊费，本利合计二十九万八千四百两。」一队码头劫骑守着门，进来的人只许看，不许问。

A large building on the street holds twenty ledger desks and twenty clerks: the Long house's main counting room. In the middle hangs a great board bearing a single sum, and every day someone climbs a ladder to change a figure: 'Berth One, unpaid berth fees, principal and interest: 298,400 taels.' Dockside raiders guard the door; you may look, but not ask.
after: 劫骑被赶出去，总账先生只好回话：这块牌子十年来天天涨，谁想要一号泊，就得交这个数。他把底账翻到最后一页，数目底下，龙爷亲笔添了一行小字：「或，一个消息。」交不起钱的，带个消息来也行。

The raiders are thrown out and the chief clerk has to answer. The board has risen every day for ten years: whoever wants Berth One pays this sum. He turns the master ledger to its last page. Under the figure, in Master Long's own hand: 'Or: one piece of news.' Anyone who can't pay may bring news instead.

name: 舢板渡
Sampan Ferry
before: 港边一个摆舢板的老艄公，专渡人去停在港里的大船。他的舢板被一队码头劫骑扣在桩上，说龙爷吩咐过，不许再渡人去一号泊。老艄公坐在船头抽旱烟，说十年前，他就是从这根桩子上，渡过一个人去追千里号。

An old ferryman at the harbour's edge sculls a sampan out to the big ships at anchor. Dockside raiders have impounded it at its post: Master Long's orders, no more ferrying anyone to Berth One. The old man sits in the bow smoking his pipe. Ten years ago, he says, it was from this very post that he ferried a man out to chase the Qianli.
after: 劫骑被赶跑，舢板解了缆。老艄公说，那夜渡的是龙家少东家，一路骂一路划，追上了千里号最后一条船。弟弟阿舟站在船舷上不肯下来，冲他喊：「哥，泊位给我留着！我回来要靠一号泊！」少东家在舢板上站了很久，回来以后，再没提过让弟弟下船。

The raiders are driven off and the sampan untied. That night, the ferryman says, he carried the young Long heir, who cursed and rowed all the way and caught the Qianli's last ship. His brother A'zhou stood at the rail and wouldn't come down. 'Brother, keep the berth for me! When I come back I'm mooring at Berth One!' The heir stood in the sampan a long time, and after that never again spoke of getting his brother off.

name: 错洞寨
Wrong-Tunnel Camp
before: 龚家船坞外的荒地上扎着个小寨子，三十来个海寇弓手。头领想偷船坞里的好木料，带人挖了半个月地道，要从篱笆底下钻进去。他们方向挖反了，挖进一片烂泥地，挖出一根又一根黑乎乎的大木头，越挖越多，越挖越不知道自己在哪儿。

On waste ground outside the Gong shipyard stands a small camp of thirty-odd pirate archers. Their chief wanted the yard's good timber and had them dig a tunnel for half a month to come up under the fence. They dug the wrong way, into a stretch of mud, and kept hauling out big black logs, more and more, with less and less idea where they were.
after: 弓手们被赶跑，地道口堆满了挖出来的木头。阿樯一看跳了起来：这是师父的师父那辈埋在泥里的老樟木，泥里不透气，几十年不腐不裂，后来谁也记不得埋在哪儿了。「蠢贼替我们挖了半个月！」她笑得直不起腰，「船上最后几根肋骨有着落了！」

The archers are run off, leaving the tunnel mouth piled with logs. A'qiang leaps in the air: it's old camphor buried in the mud by her master's master's generation. With no air down there it neither rotted nor split in decades, and in time everyone forgot where it lay. 'The fools dug for us for half a month!' She's doubled over laughing. 'That's the ship's last ribs sorted!'

name: 锯木坑
Saw Pit
before: 地上挖着一个深坑，坑上架着一根原木，本该一人在上一人在下，拉一把长锯把它锯成船板。一伙海寇刀手说船板都要抵给龙记，正一块块往外扛。坑底的老人不管不顾，一个人拉着两个人的锯，腰上挂着一只墨斗，满头满脸都是木屑。他就是龚墨斗。

A deep pit with a log laid across it: one man should stand on top and one below, pulling a long saw to cut planks. Pirate swordsmen say the planks are forfeit to the Long house and are carrying them off. The old man in the pit ignores them, working a two-man saw alone, an ink-line reel at his waist, sawdust all over his head and face. He is Gong Modou.
after: 刀手被赶走，龚墨斗才爬上来拍掉木屑。他说十年来造船的木料都是赊龙记的，赊到后来，船还没下水就先押给了龙记。「龙四海说船是押给他的。我说押归押，船我照样造。」他看了看阿樯带回的铁力木，点点头：「这根能做舵杆。可舵呢？」

The swordsmen are driven off and only then does Gong Modou climb out and brush off the sawdust. For ten years, he says, he's bought all his timber from the Long house on credit, until the ship was pledged to them before it touched water. 'Long Sihai says the ship is pledged to him. I say pledge or no, I'll keep building.' He looks over A'qiang's ironwood and nods. 'This will make a rudder post. But the rudder?'

name: 一号泊
Berth One
before: 泉州港最好的泊位，石阶磨得发亮，系船柱上缠着新麻绳，水边一盏没点的灯。泊位空着，十年没靠过一条船。几个海寇刀手每天在这里扫地、擦柱、换绳，比扫自家门口还勤快，见有船想靠就举刀撵走。今天又有一条外地船想靠，船老大正跟刀手吵。

The finest berth in Quanzhou: stone steps worn to a shine, new hemp rope round the mooring post, an unlit lamp at the water's edge. It's empty, and no ship has tied up here in ten years. A few pirate swordsmen sweep it daily, wipe the post and change the rope, more diligent than at their own doors, and wave off any ship that tries to come alongside. Today another out-of-town skipper is arguing with them.
after: 刀手被赶开，外地船骂骂咧咧撑走了。灯底下压着一块被摸得光滑的小木牌，写着「阿舟」。泊位尽头的石阶上坐着一个背影，没有回头，只抬了抬手，让刀手们退下。这就是海龙王。他在等什么，你们心里大概已经有数了。

The swordsmen are pushed aside and the skipper poles away, grumbling. Under the lamp lies a small wooden tag rubbed smooth, carved A'zhou. On the steps at the far end sits a figure with his back to you. He doesn't turn, only lifts a hand to send the swordsmen away. This is the Dragon King. What he's waiting for, you can probably guess by now.

name: 龙宅后门
Long Mansion Back Gate
before: 龙家大宅的后门开在一条窄巷里，每月初一都有人来敲门：一个腰挂墨斗的老船匠，带着扎短辫的徒弟，敲三下，喊一句「龙四海，船要造好了，把船还我」。守门的海寇弓手开门就是一顿推搡，这个月推得特别狠，老船匠摔在了台阶上。

The Long mansion's back gate opens onto a narrow alley, and on the first of every month someone knocks: an old shipwright with an ink-line reel at his waist and a short-braided apprentice. Three knocks and a shout: 'Long Sihai, the ship's nearly done, give it back!' The pirate archers on the gate answer with shoving, and this month they shove hard; the old man falls on the steps.
after: 弓手被赶跑，看门的老门房扶起龚墨斗，叹气说：「龙爷每回听你敲门，只说一句：船是押给我的，舵样也是押给我的。」他顿了顿，「可他从没让人把船拉走过。他说等船造好了，让造船的人自己来要。」

The archers are run off and the old porter helps Gong Modou up with a sigh. 'Every time Master Long hears you knock he says the same thing: the ship is pledged to me, and so is the rudder model.' He pauses. 'But he's never once had the ship hauled away. He says when it's done, the man who built it can come and ask himself.'

name: 试水湾
Test-Float Cove
before: 避风的小海湾里浮着一段船身，没有桅也没有帆，是龚墨斗造好的一截船肚子，拖到这里试水。一伙海寇弓手在岸上拿它当靶子，一箭一箭地射，赌谁先把它射沉。射了一上午，船板扎满了箭，三个舱都在往外冒水，那截船身还漂着，弓手们急得直跺脚。

In a sheltered cove floats a length of hull with no mast or sail: a finished section of Gong Modou's ship's belly, towed here for a float test. Pirate archers on the shore use it as a target, betting who'll sink it first. All morning they've shot; the planks bristle with arrows and three holds spurt water, yet it still floats. The archers stamp in frustration.
after: 弓手被赶跑，龚墨斗划过去挨个舱查了一遍，笑得胡子直翘：「破了三个舱，剩下的照样托得住。千里号当年就是这么造的，我这条也一样。」他拔下一支箭，在船板上划了个记号：「这一舱，下水前再补。」

The archers are chased off and Gong Modou rows over to check every hold, beaming so his beard sticks up. 'Three holds holed and the rest still hold her up. That's how the Qianli was built, and so is mine.' He pulls an arrow and scratches a mark on a plank. 'Patch this one before launch.'

name: 灯笼担
Lantern Porters
before: 去一号泊的路上走来一队挑担的人，扁担两头挂满「千」字灯笼，都是千灯巷的街坊，陈婆走在最前头。一伙海寇刀手拦在路口，说龙爷的地界不许挂这个字，要把灯笼一担担扔进海里。陈婆把扁担往地上一顿：「我这是给一号泊送的灯，你们问问龙四海，他敢不敢收。」

Along the road to Berth One comes a line of porters with Qian lanterns hung from both ends of their poles: neighbours from Thousand-Lantern Lane, Granny Chen at the front. Pirate swordsmen block the junction: that character isn't allowed on Master Long's ground, and the lanterns are going into the sea. Granny Chen thumps her pole down. 'These are a delivery for Berth One. Go and ask Long Sihai if he dares accept them.'
after: 刀手被打散，一个跑去报信，回来时脸色古怪：「龙爷说，灯笼……放进来。」灯笼一担担挑到一号泊外，摆了长长一溜。泊位尽头那个背影动了一下，像是数了一遍。一盏也没少。

The swordsmen are scattered. One runs to report and returns with a strange look. 'Master Long says... let the lanterns in.' Load after load is carried to the edge of Berth One and laid out in a long row. The figure at the far end stirs, as if counting them. Not one is missing.

name: 龙记船厂
Long Shipyard
before: 海边一片大船厂，十几座船台上架着龙记的新船，锤声、锯声、号子声连成一片。厂里的工匠一半是从龚家船坞挖来的，工钱高，活干得憋屈：工头拿着偷来的千里号图样非要照着造，造了三条，下水全都歪着走。守厂的刀手、弓手、劫骑一大群，比工匠还多。

A great shipyard spreads along the shore, a dozen slipways holding Long house ships, hammering, sawing and work chants rolling together. Half its craftsmen were poached from the Gong yard; the pay is good and the work maddening. The foreman insists on building to stolen plans of the Qianli: three ships so far, and all three crab sideways once launched. The guards, swordsmen, archers and riders, outnumber the craftsmen.
after: 打手们被打散，工匠们扔下家伙，一半跟着阿樯回了龚家船坞。龙记工头蹲在船台下抓头皮：「图样一根线都没画错，怎么就是不走直？」龚墨斗瞥了一眼：「你缺了舵。船样上没有，图上也没有。千里号的舵，是另造的。」

The guards scatter and the craftsmen down tools; half follow A'qiang back to the Gong yard. The Long foreman squats under a slipway tearing at his scalp. 'Not one line of those plans is wrong. Why won't they sail straight?' Gong Modou glances over. 'You're missing the rudder. It's not on the model and not on the plans. The Qianli's rudder was made separately.'

name: 龙宅外院
Long Mansion Forecourt
before: 龙家大宅的外院铺着青石板，院中一口大鱼缸，只养着一只老海龟，龟壳上刻着歪歪扭扭一个「舟」字。一伙海寇刀手正在院里操练，喊杀声震得海龟把头缩进了壳里。听说开拓队要来，他们得了令：不许伤人，可也不许让人轻易进来。

The Long mansion's forecourt is paved with bluestone, a great tank in the middle holding nothing but one old sea turtle, a wobbly Zhou scratched into its shell. Pirate swordsmen are drilling in the yard, their war cries so loud the turtle has pulled in its head. Word has come that the pioneer party is on its way, and their orders are: hurt no one, but don't let anyone in easily.
after: 刀手被赶进了内院，福伯出来收拾场面。他说这海龟是二少爷阿舟小时候从海滩捡回来的，壳上的字是他刻的。「离八月十八还有八天，龙爷十年没在那一夜睡过觉。他吩咐了：那一夜之前，谁带着东西来，他在一号泊见。」

The swordsmen are driven into the inner court and Uncle Fu comes out to settle things. The turtle, he says, was picked up off the beach by the second young master, A'zhou, as a boy, and the character is his work. 'Eight days to the eighteenth of the eighth month. In ten years Master Long hasn't slept that night. His orders: whoever comes before then bringing something, he'll see at Berth One.'

name: 观潮亭
Tide-Watching Pavilion
before: 港口最高的崖头上有座亭子，正对着河口沙坝。亭里一张躺椅，椅边一只铜壶，壶嘴冲着海。一队码头劫骑守在亭下，不许人上去。从亭里往下看，沙嘴尖上那排红布竹篙清清楚楚，在风里一抖一抖。几个劫骑提着刀，正为谁去拔那些篙吵架。

On the highest headland above the harbour stands a pavilion facing the bar at the river mouth: a reclining chair, a copper kettle beside it, spout toward the sea. Dockside raiders guard the foot and let no one up. From up here the row of red-flagged poles on the spit's tip is plain to see, fluttering in the wind. A few raiders, blades in hand, are arguing over who should go and pull them up.
after: 劫骑被赶下去，头目才说实话：龙爷下过令，红篙谁也不许拔，拔一根打断一只手。「龙爷天天坐在这亭里看那丫头插篙，一根一根数。我们想拔，是怕他看着难受。」躺椅扶手上压着一张纸，画着新水道的弯，画得不太准。

The raiders are driven down and their chief finally comes clean: Master Long has ordered that no one touches those poles; pull one and lose a hand. 'He sits here every day watching the girl plant them, counting one by one. We wanted them gone because we thought it hurt him to watch.' On the armrest lies a sketch of the new channel's curve, not very accurate.

name: 船匠祠
Shipwrights' Shrine
before: 一座供着鲁班的祠堂，是泉州船匠的行会，每年开工、下水都在这里上香。一伙海寇刀手占了祠堂开赌，拿鲁班爷的供桌当赌桌，拿墨斗线弹赌局的界线。行会的老把头们站在门外敢怒不敢言，有一个气得把烟杆都咬断了。

A shrine to Lu Ban, patron of craftsmen, and home of the Quanzhou shipwrights' guild, where incense is lit at every season's start and every launch. Pirate swordsmen have made it a gambling den, using Lu Ban's altar as a table and snapping ink lines to mark the betting board. The guild's old foremen stand outside, seething; one has bitten clean through his pipe stem.
after: 刀手被赶出去，供桌擦净，香又点上了。老把头们听说龚墨斗的船只差最后几天的活，商量了一袋烟的工夫，拍板：行会出四十个木匠，八天里帮他收尾。「十年前千里号下水，是这间祠里上的香，」把头说，「这一回，也得是。」

The swordsmen are thrown out, the altar wiped, the incense relit. Hearing that Gong Modou's ship needs only a few more days' work, the foremen confer for the length of a pipe and decide: the guild will send forty carpenters to finish it within eight days. 'Ten years ago the Qianli's launch incense was lit in this shrine,' says one. 'This time it will be too.'

name: 龚家小院
The Gong Cottage
before: 船坞边一座小院，院里晾着补了又补的衣裳。龚婶握着擀面杖站在院门口，对面一队码头劫骑，说龚墨斗欠龙记木料钱，要拿房子抵。龚婶把擀面杖一横：「房子是我的嫁妆，嫁妆早卖了买木头。剩下这几间破屋，要拿，先过我这一关。」

Beside the shipyard is a small cottage, much-mended clothes drying in its yard. Auntie Gong stands at the gate with a rolling pin facing a troop of dockside raiders: Gong Modou owes the Long house for timber and they'll take the house. She levels the pin. 'The house was my dowry, and the dowry went on timber long ago. If you want what's left of these shabby rooms, get past me first.'
after: 劫骑被赶跑，龚婶塞给你们一碗热汤面。她骂了老头子十年，「败家，倔，木头比老婆亲」，可每天中午照样把饭送到船坞。她说他造这条船，是因为沈船主看过他的船，说了一句：「你造的是好船，可还不够好。造一条能追上我的。」「他这辈子，最受不了这句。」

The raiders are driven off and Auntie Gong presses a bowl of hot noodle soup on you. Ten years she's railed at the old man, 'wastrel, mule, fonder of wood than of his wife', yet every noon she carries his meal to the yard. He builds this ship, she says, because Shipmaster Shen once looked at his work and said: 'You build good ships, but not good enough. Build one that can catch me.' 'All his life he's never been able to stand being told that.'

name: 鼠沟
Rat Drain
before: 船坞底下有一条通海的大阴沟，住着一帮「老鼠帮」：在地下讨生活的小贼，跟真老鼠一起住，一起偷。船坞里的铜钉、麻绳、桐油，夜里总要少一截。守沟口的刀手、弓手、劫骑都是帮里的，劫骑骑的是驴，在沟里跑得比马快。沟里的老鼠比人还多，啃起缆绳来，一夜就是一根。

Under the shipyard runs a great drain to the sea, home of the Rat Gang: petty thieves who live and steal underground alongside real rats. Every night the yard is short some copper nails, a length of rope, a dab of tung oil. The swordsmen, archers and riders guarding the drain mouth are all gang, the riders on donkeys that outrun horses down there. The rats outnumber the people and can gnaw through a cable in a night.
after: 这一回老鼠帮被赶出了阴沟，偷去的铜钉捞回两筐。可阴沟四通八达，堵了这头还有那头；老鼠一窝窝地生，城里没饭吃的孩子也总有人往沟里钻。过一阵老鼠帮还会回来，船坞的人只好隔些日子就来清一回。

This time the Rat Gang is flushed out and two baskets of nails fished back. But the drains run everywhere: block one end and there's another. The rats breed litter after litter, and there are always hungry children who'll crawl down there. Before long the gang will be back, and the yard folk will have to clear it out again every so often.

name: 泡木洲
Soaking-Timber Isle
before: 港外一座小岛，岛边浅水里泡着一根根大木头，用石头压着：龚墨斗把买来的木料泡在海水里，泡上几年，浆水泡掉了，日后不裂不蛀。一伙海寇刀手占了岛，嫌木头碍事，捞上来劈了当柴烧，烧的偏是最好的几根杉木。

On a small island outside the harbour, great logs lie soaking in the shallows under stones: Gong Modou soaks his timber in seawater for years so the sap leaches out, and afterwards it neither splits nor gets worm. Pirate swordsmen have taken the island, found the logs a nuisance, and are splitting them for firewood, the best fir first.
after: 刀手被赶下岛，剩下的木头又压回了水里，烧掉的不多。岛上的老看木人守这片水十年，每根木头哪年下的水，闭着眼都摸得出来。他拍着一根杉木：「这几根泡够了，捞上去，正好赶上船下水。」

The swordsmen are driven off and the remaining logs weighed back down; not many were burned. The old timber-keeper has watched this water ten years and can tell by touch, eyes shut, which year each log went in. He pats a fir trunk. 'These have soaked long enough. Haul them out now and they'll be just in time for the launch.'
first: 岛上抄出刀手们囤的两船柴火、三缸淡水、一窝刚孵出来的鸭子，还有一桶拿船钉换来的米酒。
On the island you seize the swordsmen's stores: two boatloads of firewood, three vats of fresh water, a brood of new ducklings, and a cask of rice wine they'd bartered ship nails for.
pass: 每次路过，老看木人都撑船送来一筐岛边摸的花蛤，再捎几块晒干的边角木料，「路上烧火，比柴好烧」。
Every time you pass, the old timber-keeper poles out with a basket of clams dug at the island's edge and a few dried offcuts. 'For your fires on the road. Burns better than kindling.'

name: 码头公所
Dock Guild Hall
before: 码头公所里吵成了一锅粥，泉州各家船行的东家都来了，桌上摊着市舶司续航榜文的抄本。有人要跟着柯提举作保，有人怕得罪龙记，吵到最后拍了桌子。门口站着一伙龙记派来「旁听」的海寇刀手，谁嗓门大，刀手就把刀鞘往地上一顿。

The dock guild hall is in uproar, every shipping house in Quanzhou there, a copy of the Office's continued-voyage notice on the table. Some want to stand surety beside Superintendent Ke; some fear crossing the Long house; it ends in fists on tables. At the door stand pirate swordsmen sent by the Long house to 'observe', thumping their scabbards whenever anyone speaks too loudly.
after: 刀手被请了出去，屋里一下子静了。柯提举带着七号驳的文书赶来：瓷点清了，公凭盖了大印，舶牌找回了，庄窑主也按了手印。船东们一个个在后头添上名字。「就差一个手印，」柯提举收好保状，「龙家的。他在一号泊等着。」

The swordsmen are shown out and the room goes quiet. Superintendent Ke arrives with barge No. 7's papers: porcelain counted, certificate stamped with the great seal, tally recovered, Master Zhuang's thumbprint pressed. One by one the shipowners add their names. 'One thumbprint missing,' says Ke, putting the surety away. 'The Long house's. He's waiting at Berth One.'

name: 玩舵潭
Tiller Pools
before: 海边礁石间有几汪退潮留下的水潭，一个缺了两根手指的老舵工带着一群孩子在潭里放木头小船，教他们怎么扳舵。一伙海寇刀手嫌孩子吵，把小船一条条踩碎。老舵工把最后一条护在怀里，那条船的舵能上下抽动，是他亲手刻的。

Among the shore rocks lie pools left by the ebb, where an old helmsman missing two fingers teaches a crowd of children to sail little wooden boats and work a tiller. Pirate swordsmen, sick of the noise, stamp the boats to pieces one by one. The old man shields the last against his chest. Its rudder slides up and down; he carved it himself.
after: 刀手被赶走，孩子们又围了上来。老舵工说他年纪大没跟上千里号，可千里号的舵是他和沈船主一起琢磨的：升降舵，遇上浅滩提起来，到了深水再放下，「过沙坝全靠它」。舵样只有一个，沈船主走前押在龙家：「她说谁来续航，龙家就把舵交给谁。」

The swordsmen are chased off and the children crowd back. He was too old to sail with the Qianli, the helmsman says, but he and Shipmaster Shen worked out its rudder together: a lifting rudder, raised over shoals and lowered in deep water. 'Crossing the bar depends on it.' There was one rudder model, and before she left Shen pledged it to the Long house. 'She said whoever comes to continue the voyage, the Long house hands it to them.'

name: 坞前路
Yard Approach Road
before: 去龚家船坞只有一条土路，行会的四十个木匠扛着工具、推着木料往坞里赶，一队码头劫骑横在路上，马头一字排开，说船是押给龙记的，坞里不许再添一钉一木。木匠们把斧头扛在肩上跟马对瞪，谁也不让谁。

Only one dirt road leads to the Gong yard. The guild's forty carpenters hurry along it with tools and barrows of timber, but dockside raiders block the road, horses' heads in a line: the ship is pledged to the Long house, and not one more nail or plank goes into that yard. The carpenters shoulder their axes and glare back at the horses. Nobody gives way.
after: 劫骑被冲散，四十个木匠喊着号子涌进船坞，锤子一响就是一夜。领头的劫骑临走嘟囔了一句：「龙爷只说不许把船拉走，没说不许造……是我们多事了。」

The raiders are scattered and the forty carpenters pour into the yard chanting, hammers going all night. Leaving, the raiders' leader mutters, 'Master Long only said nobody hauls the ship away. He never said nobody builds it... We overdid it.'

name: 点睛台
Eye-Dotting Platform
before: 坞外的高台上摆着香案，是给新船下水「点睛」的地方：泉州的船头两边要画一对龙目，下水那天点上眼珠，船才认得路。阿樯已经把龙目画好了，眼眶里空着。一伙海寇弓手占了高台，说点睛得交「开光钱」，不交就拿箭把龙目射瞎。

On a high platform outside the yard stands an incense table, where a new ship's eyes are dotted before launch: Quanzhou ships carry a pair of dragon eyes on the bow, and on launch day the pupils are dotted in so the ship can see its way. A'qiang has painted the eyes, the sockets still blank. Pirate archers have taken the platform demanding 'consecration money', or they'll shoot the eyes blind.
after: 弓手被赶跑，香案扶了起来。龚墨斗提着蘸了朱砂的笔，却没有点下去。他说行里的规矩，点睛要请船的主家来点：「船押在龙家，泊位是龙家的，舵样也在龙家。这一笔，得请龙四海来点。」

The archers are driven off and the table set upright. Gong Modou lifts a brush dipped in cinnabar but doesn't put it to the eyes. By the trade's custom, he says, the ship's owner does the dotting. 'The ship is pledged to the Long house, the berth is theirs, the rudder model is with them. This stroke has to be Long Sihai's.'

name: 老锚记
Old Anchor Chandlery
before: 一号泊旁边有一家船具店，锚、缆、铁链、罗盘、风灯挂了满墙，门口却挂着一块牌子：「本店不卖。」店主是个瘸腿的老船具商，十年前龙家把店里的东西全包了，说是给一号泊的船预备的，不许卖给别人。一伙海寇弓手坐在店里看着，来一个买主轰一个。

Beside Berth One stands a chandlery, its walls hung with anchors, cables, chains, compasses and storm lanterns, but the sign at the door reads 'Nothing for sale.' Ten years ago the Long house bought the lame old chandler's whole stock for the ships of Berth One, to be sold to no one else. Pirate archers sit in the shop and chase off every buyer.
after: 弓手被赶出店门，老船具商把牌子翻过来，背面写着「开张」。他佩服你们，愿意换货：「龙爷包了十年，我也闷了十年。」临走他摘下一盘新缆递过来：「这是给一号泊备的。你们去见他，就说是我借你们的，他不会不认。」

The archers are turned out and the old chandler flips the sign: the back reads 'Open'. Impressed, he's willing to trade. 'Master Long kept me bottled up ten years, and I've been bored stiff.' As you go he hands you a coil of new rope. 'Laid by for Berth One. When you see him, say I lent it to you. He won't refuse to recognise it.'

name: 鱼市岛
Fish-Market Isle
before: 港外的小岛上天天清早开鱼市，渔船一靠岸就卖，石斑、黄鱼、梭子蟹，活蹦乱跳。这一个月，鱼市被一伙海寇弓手占了，说岛上的冰窖归他们，没冰鱼就臭，鱼贩们只好贱卖给弓手。卖鱼的阿婆们个个嗓门大，骂了一个月，骂得弓手们耳朵都起了茧。

On a small island outside the harbour a fish market opens every dawn as the boats come in: grouper, yellow croaker, swimming crabs, all still flapping. For a month pirate archers have held it, claiming the island's ice house; without ice the fish stink, so the mongers must sell cheap to them. The fishwives have voices like foghorns and have cursed for a month, till the archers' ears are calloused.
after: 弓手被赶下岛，冰窖打开，鱼市又热闹起来。阿婆们佩服你们，拿最好的鱼跟你们换货，还说龚家船坞那四十个木匠八天的饭，鱼市包了。一个阿婆说：「那条船要是去找千里号，替我捎句话给我男人：工钱不要了，人回来就行。」

The archers are driven off, the ice house opened, and the market bustles again. The fishwives, impressed, trade you their best fish, and say the fish market will feed the Gong yard's forty carpenters all eight days. One old woman says, 'If that ship goes looking for the Qianli, take my husband a message: keep the wages. Just come home.'

name: 坞口茶寮
Yard-Mouth Tea Shed
before: 船坞口有间茶寮，一个穿绸衫的中年人天天坐在这里喝茶，盯着坞里的新船，一坐一整天。他是龙记派来的「看船人」，身边跟着一队码头劫骑。今天四十个木匠进了坞，他坐不住了，叫劫骑把坞口堵上，自己在茶寮里来回踱步，茶凉了也没喝一口。

At the yard mouth is a tea shed where a middle-aged man in a silk gown sits all day drinking tea and watching the new ship. He's the Long house's 'ship-watcher', a troop of dockside raiders at his side. Today forty carpenters have gone in and he can't sit still; he has the raiders block the mouth and paces the shed, his tea gone cold.
after: 劫骑被打散，看船人只好坐下交代：他每月给龙爷报一回船造到几成，十年里从一成报到九成九。龙爷每回只问一句：「舵呢？」他就答：「舵样在您手里。」今天他回去要报的是：「船齐了，只差舵和一笔点睛。」

The raiders scatter and the ship-watcher has to sit and tell all. Every month he reports how far the ship has come; in ten years, from one part in ten to ninety-nine in a hundred. Every time Master Long asks only, 'And the rudder?' and he answers, 'The rudder model is in your hands, sir.' Today his report will be: 'The ship is complete, save the rudder and one dot of the eyes.'

name: 龙家亲兵营
Long Guard Camp
before: 去一号泊的最后一段路上扎着龙家的亲兵营，营门两边插着龙旗。营里的刀手、弓手、劫骑都是跟了龙四海十年的老人，个个身上有疤。头领抱着刀站在营门口，传龙爷的话：「谁带着东西来，先过亲兵营。连亲兵营都过不去，就别去一号泊丢人了。」

On the last stretch of road to Berth One stands the Long house guard camp, dragon banners either side of the gate. Its swordsmen, archers and riders have followed Long Sihai for ten years, every one scarred. Their captain stands at the gate, blade folded in his arms, and gives Master Long's word: 'Whoever comes bringing something gets past the guard camp first. If you can't even manage that, don't go and embarrass yourselves at Berth One.'
after: 亲兵们败了，头领收刀让路，还冲你们拱了拱手：「龙爷说过，过得了亲兵营的，就是能把船带出去的人。」他朝一号泊一指：「八月十八之前，他都坐在那儿。带上你们该带的东西。」

The guards are beaten. Their captain sheathes his blade, steps aside and salutes you with clasped hands. 'Master Long said: whoever gets past the guard camp can take a ship out.' He points toward Berth One. 'Until the eighteenth, he'll be sitting there. Bring what you've come to bring.'

name: 船工饭堂
Dockhands' Canteen
before: 一号泊后面有座大饭堂，码头的苦力、船工、木匠都在这里吃饭，一张长桌能坐一百人。一伙海寇刀手占了饭堂，说龙爷要见客，码头上的闲人一律不许聚，把大锅都扣了过来。饭点到了，饭堂外蹲着一圈饿肚子的人：有渔家姑娘，有穿官袍的，有拄拐的老太太，都是来一号泊的。

Behind Berth One stands a great canteen where coolies, boatmen and carpenters eat at one long table for a hundred. Pirate swordsmen have taken it, saying Master Long is receiving guests and no idlers may gather, and turned the big pots upside down. Mealtime has come, and outside squats a ring of hungry people: a fisher girl, a man in an official robe, an old woman on a stick, all here for Berth One.
after: 刀手被赶走，大锅翻过来，饭堂里坐满了人。阿汐抱着潮信簿，柯提举揣着保状，陈婆守着三百盏灯，龚墨斗和阿樯身上还沾着木屑，头一回坐到了一张桌上。龙老太端来一锅面线糊：「吃饱了，再去见我那个犟儿子。」

The swordsmen are thrown out, the pots set right, and the canteen fills. A'xi with her tide book, Superintendent Ke with his surety, Granny Chen guarding three hundred lanterns, Gong Modou and A'qiang still dusted with sawdust: for the first time they sit at one table. Old Mother Long brings a pot of thread-noodle porridge. 'Eat your fill, then go and see that mule-headed son of mine.'
first: 饭堂里抄出刀手们藏的三十斤咸肉、五袋白米、一筐鸭蛋，还有一摞龙记饭票，背面盖着「一号泊专用」，十年里一张也没用过。

In the canteen you find what the swordsmen hid: thirty catties of salt pork, five sacks of rice, a basket of duck eggs, and a stack of Long house meal tickets stamped 'Berth One only' on the back, not one used in ten years.
pass: 每次路过，饭堂的大师傅都给你们多盛一勺，说「一号泊的人，饭管够」，临走还塞一包刚出锅的炸枣。
Every time you pass, the head cook gives you an extra ladleful, 'Berth One's people eat their fill', and slips you a packet of fried sesame balls hot from the pan.

name: 桅杆岬
Mast Headland
before: 海边一道伸进海里的石岬，岬头横躺着一根十来丈长的大杉木，用铁链锁在礁石上。这是龚墨斗十年前买下的主桅，泡好了，晾干了，却被龙记当成欠债扣在这里。守岬的是龙记最凶的打手：刀手守链，弓手占着高处，劫骑在岬颈上来回巡。海风一吹，桅木呜呜地响。

A rocky headland juts into the sea, and on its tip lies a fir trunk a hundred feet long, chained to the rocks: the mainmast Gong Modou bought ten years ago, soaked and seasoned, then impounded here by the Long house against his debts. The Long house's fiercest bruisers guard it: swordsmen at the chains, archers on the heights, raiders patrolling the neck of the headland. When the sea wind blows, the timber hums.
after: 打手被赶下岬，铁链砸开。四十个木匠喊着号子把主桅扛上肩，一步步抬回船坞，路边的人都出来看。龚墨斗摸着桅木笑：「龙四海扣着它，倒替我看了十年，一点没裂。」

The bruisers are driven off and the chains smashed. Chanting, the forty carpenters shoulder the mast and carry it step by step to the yard while people come out along the road to watch. Gong Modou runs a hand along it, smiling. 'Long Sihai impounded it and looked after it for me for ten years. Not a crack.'

name: 坞工棚
Yard Workers' Sheds
before: 船坞边一排工棚，来了四十个木匠，根本住不下。一伙海寇弓手偏占着最大的两间，躺在木匠的铺盖上晒太阳，说这是龙记的工棚，外来的木匠只能睡露天。木匠们干了一天活，夜里抱着斧头在船底下打地铺，被蚊子咬得满身是包。

A row of work sheds by the yard is too few for forty carpenters, and pirate archers are occupying the two biggest, lounging on the carpenters' bedrolls in the sun: Long house sheds, they say, and outside carpenters can sleep in the open. After a day's work the carpenters bed down under the hull clutching their axes, bitten all over by mosquitoes.
after: 弓手被赶出工棚，木匠们总算睡上了铺。陈婆派千灯巷的孩子送来几十盏灯笼，挂在棚檐下照着船坞，木匠们连夜干活。新船的船头上，阿樯用红漆写了三个字：后千里。

The archers are turned out and the carpenters finally have beds. Granny Chen sends Thousand-Lantern Lane's children with dozens of lanterns to hang from the eaves and light the yard, and the carpenters work on through the night. On the new ship's bow A'qiang paints three characters in red lacquer: Later Qianli.
first: 工棚里抄出弓手们囤的二十条棉被、一箱铁钉、两坛老酒，还有一口从船坞偷来的大铁锅，锅底刻着「龚」字。
In the sheds you seize the archers' stores: twenty quilts, a chest of iron nails, two jars of aged wine, and a great wok stolen from the yard, Gong carved on its base.
pass: 每次路过，木匠们都塞给你们几件顺手做的小木器：一把木勺、一只木碗、一块刻着「千」字的木牌，说「路上用，坏了再来拿」。
Every time you pass, the carpenters press handmade wooden things on you: a spoon, a bowl, a tag carved with Qian. 'For the road. When they break, come back for more.'

name: 后千里坞
Later-Qianli Dock
before: 礁石后面藏着一个船坞，坞里架着一条新船：三桅，十三舱，船头一对龙目还没点睛，船尾的舵孔空空的。这就是龚墨斗造了十年的「后千里」。坞门却被龙记最精锐的打手堵着，刀手、弓手、劫骑排得密不透风，领头的举着一张押契：「船押龙记，债未清，一寸也不许下水。」

Hidden behind the rocks is a dock holding a new ship: three masts, thirteen holds, dragon eyes on the bow still undotted, the rudder well at the stern empty. This is the Later Qianli, Gong Modou's ten years of work. But the Long house's finest block the dock gate, swordsmen, archers and riders packed shoulder to shoulder, their leader brandishing a pledge deed: 'Ship pledged to the Long house. Debt unpaid. Not one inch touches water.'
after: 打手们败了，押契被风吹进了海。龚墨斗从船头走到船尾，一块板一块板地敲，最后站在空舵孔边半天没说话。「船好了，追得上她。」他终于开口，「可没有舵，连沙坝都过不去。舵样在龙四海手里。走，咱们去要。」

The bruisers are beaten and the pledge deed blows away into the sea. Gong Modou walks the ship bow to stern, rapping every plank, then stands by the empty rudder well a long time. 'She's done. She can catch her,' he says at last. 'But without a rudder she can't even cross the bar. The rudder model is in Long Sihai's hands. Come on. Let's go and ask for it.'

name: 龙王阶
The Dragon King's Steps
before: 一号泊的尽头，石阶一级级没进水里。海龙王龙四海坐在最下面一级，五十来岁，一件旧绸衫，膝上一只木匣，身边一盏没点的灯。他身后三路人马排开：亲兵劫骑在前，刀手两翼，弓手压住石阶。你们带来的东西摆了一地：潮信簿、保状、三百盏灯笼、一条没有舵的船。他看了一眼，没起身：「十年泊费，二十九万八千四百两。要么交钱，要么拿一个消息来。都没有？那就打。打得过，咱们再算账。」

At the end of Berth One the stone steps run down into the water. The Dragon King, Long Sihai, sits on the lowest: about fifty, an old silk gown, a wooden box on his knees, an unlit lamp beside him. Behind him his forces stand three columns wide: guard riders in front, swordsmen on the wings, archers holding the steps. What you've brought is laid out before him: a tide book, a surety, three hundred lanterns, a ship without a rudder. He glances at it all and doesn't rise. 'Ten years' berth fees, 298,400 taels. Pay, or bring me one piece of news. Neither? Then we fight. Win, and we'll settle accounts after.'
after: 海龙王败了，坐在石阶上喘了半天，打开木匣：里面是一只能上下抽动的木舵。「她押在我这儿的，说谁来续航，就交给谁。」他在保状上按了手印，把潮信簿还给阿汐，提笔给后千里点了睛，又给炮台写了一句：「千字灯，放。」「那夜我没拦住弟弟，只拦下了一船瓷。消息你们没带来，那就替我去取。千里号往东南进了雾海，雾里有个提督奉命截船。阿舟要是还活着，就在雾里。」八月十八子时，大潮涨满，后千里挂着三百盏灯，沿着红篙出了港门。

Beaten, the Dragon King sits on the steps a long while catching his breath, then opens the box: inside is a carved wooden rudder that slides up and down. 'She pledged it to me. Said whoever came to continue the voyage should have it.' He presses his thumb to the surety, returns the tide book to A'xi, dots the Later Qianli's eyes with his own brush, and writes one line to the fort: 'Qian lanterns: let them pass.' 'That night I couldn't stop my brother. All I stopped was a boatload of porcelain. You haven't brought me news, so go and fetch it. The Qianli went southeast into the Fog Sea, where an admiral was ordered to stop it. If A'zhou is alive, he's in the fog.' At midnight on the eighteenth of the eighth month, on the full flood of the great tide, the Later Qianli, hung with three hundred lanterns, follows the red poles out through the harbour gate.
